Activities

  • Practical exposure to key technical areas
  • Company visits
  • Interactions with professors and researchers
  • A few classes alongside other students

Learn. Explore. Grow.

2-weeks, fully guided internship experience hosted at technical and business universities across the schengen countries.

01

International exposure

Step onto a European campus and experience how research, industry, and academia connect outside India.

02

Build your skills

Hands-on labs, live demonstrations, and technical sessions led by professors and researchers in your field.

03

Explore new opportunities

Meet international students, visit companies, and open doors to future study or internship pathways.

EU Internships powered by
Europe Study Centre

Europe Study Centre(ESC) is a leading overseas education consultancy with over 15 years of experience guiding Indian students to top ranked public universities across Schengen countries including Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Belgium, Slovakia, and Hungary offering access to affordable, high quality, research driven education.

Unlike agencies that promote high cost or commission based institutions, ESC focuses exclusively on public universities known for academic excellence and global recognition, with end-to-end support from admissions to on-ground assistance.
